title: How ocean container shipping rates are set
variant: Long read with no diagram: seven things in order
prompt: Explain how ocean container shipping rates are set, for a small importer getting quotes.
note: A long read at a narrow measure, serif title and body with small-caps section headings and no diagram, because the mechanism here is a market rather than a machine and reads better as seven things that happen in order than as boxes and arrows. The misconceptions are pull quotes in the reader's own words with the correction as a paragraph under each, and a five-term glossary strip sits before the further reading so the words on the reader's actual quotes are defined where they will look for them.
